analysis.summary: Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY25, highlighting stable production volumes despite material price headwinds and margin compression. The company is pursuing strategic expansion, including the commissioning of a 10 MW WHRB power plant, environmental clearance for capacity expansion, and the incorporation of new subsidiaries for backward integration and recycling entry. Management emphasized its strong B2B customer base, operational resilience, and strategic location advantages within the Haldia port perimeter. Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, achieving a turnover of Rs. 57,665.15 lakhs compared to Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the fortune of the CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of the aluminium industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Fortune of CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of aluminium industry

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation, and packaging industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation and packaging industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Expansion of aluminium smelting capacities in India, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia is expected to provide long-term growth opportunities for CPC manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Expansion of aluminium smelting capacities in India, the Middle East and Southeast Asia is expected to provide long-term growth opportunities for CPC manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The global transition towards electric mobility and clean energy technologies is also expected to support demand for carbon materials and high-quality petroleum coke products.
demand_outlook.quote: The global transition towards electric mobility and clean energy technologies is also expected to support demand for carbon materials and high-quality petroleum coke products.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing investments in battery manufacturing and energy storage infrastructure are creating additional opportunities across the carbon value chain.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing investments in battery manufacturing and energy storage infrastructure are creating additional opportunities across the carbon value chain.

demand_outlook.claim: Continued emphasis on infrastructure development, power transmission projects, railway modernization, urbanization, and industrial growth in India is expected to support demand for aluminium and steel.
demand_outlook.quote: In India, continued emphasis on infrastructure development, power transmission projects, railway modernization, urbanization and industrial growth is expected to support demand for aluminium and steel, thereby strengthening the outlook for CPC and related carbon products.

demand_outlook.claim: Government initiatives such as Make in India, Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes, and increased capital expenditure on infrastructure are expected to provide further growth momentum to downstream industries consuming CPC.
demand_outlook.quote: Government initiatives such as “Make in India”, Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes and increased capital expenditure on infrastructure are expected to provide further growth momentum to downstream industries consuming CPC.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the fiscal year witnessed a drop in sales volumes and pricing pressure affecting overall segment performance.
demand_outlook.quote: FY25 witnessed a drop in sales volumes and pricing pressure, affecting overall segment performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company has invested Rs. 5,638.11 Lakhs in projects currently under construction (CWIP).
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has invested Rs. 5,638.11 Lakhs in projects currently under construction (CWIP).

capex_expansion.claim: During the 2024-25 financial year, a 10 MW power plant was commissioned at the Haldia factory, incurring a capital expenditure of Rs. 7,111.77 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: During the FY 2024-25, 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory of the Company on 6th March, 2025 and the Company has incurred Capital Expenditure of Rs.7,111.77 lakhs for the same.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received approval from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change for a proposed expansion project involving a 72,000 TPA Electrically Calcined Anthracite Plant, a 60,000 TPA Coal Tar Distillation Plant, and a 48,000 TPA carbon paste plant revamping.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has got approval of Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India, vide their letter dated 23rd April, 2025, for proposed expansion project of the existing plant located in Haldia, West Bengal by installation of 72,000 TPA Electrically Calcined Anthracite Plant, 60,000 TPA Coal Tar Distillation Plant and 48,000 TPA by revamping of Old Carbon Paste Plant.

margins_costs.claim: Elevated raw material prices in FY25 could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression and a weakened bottom line across the sector.
margins_costs.quote: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025, primarily due to elevated raw material prices. These increases could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression and a weakened bottom line across the sector.

margins_costs.claim: The energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power and fuel inflation.
margins_costs.quote: Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power/fuel inflation.

margins_costs.claim: Profit Before Tax for FY 2025-26 registered an increase of 352.84% due to higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC, and consequently higher gross profit margins.
margins_costs.quote: Further, Profit Before Tax (PBT) for FY 2025-26 was Rs. 3353.38 lakhs as against Rs.740.53 lakhs in the previous FY 2024-25, registering an increase of 352.84% due to higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC and consequently the higher gross profit margin.

orders_capacity.claim: The plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC.
orders_capacity.quote: The Plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC and the plant comprises an area of around 30 acres with good infrastructure facilities like own railway sliding inside the plant premises itself facilitating unloading / loading of wagons, along with yard / shed to store both Raw Petroleum Coke (RPC) / Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC).

orders_capacity.claim: Production of calcined petroleum coke for the fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: In order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements, the Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements, your Directors have decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year, the Company spent Rs. 90.77 lakhs on Corporate Social Responsibility activities against a required amount of Rs. 86.79 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year ended 31st March, 2026, the Company has spent Rs.90.77 lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025 primarily due to volatility and elevation in raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in Raw Material Prices The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025, primarily due to elevated raw material prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy reliance on imports, especially low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and other Europe and Asian countries, affects cost and availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Heavy reliance on imports (esp. low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and Other Europe and Asian countries) affects cost and availability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Demand is tied to the aluminium, steel, and battery sectors, which are each sensitive to economic cycles.
risks_headwinds.quote: Demand tied to aluminium, steel, and battery sectors—each sensitive to economic cycles.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade restrictions and tariffs such as anti-dumping duties or export and import restrictions in key markets impact pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Trade Restrictions & Tariffs Anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets (e.g., China, USA and West Asia Market) impact pricing.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to face challenges arising from volatility in crude oil and green petroleum coke prices, fluctuations in freight and logistics costs, and environmental and emission-related regulatory requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: The industry, however, continues to face challenges arising from: • Volatility in crude oil and green petroleum coke prices; • Fluctuations in freight and logistics costs; • Environmental and emission-related regulatory requirements; • Supply-demand imbalances in global petroleum coke markets; • Geopolitical developments affecting energy markets and international trade.

risks_headwinds.claim: Availability of low-sulphur green petroleum coke, a key raw material for CPC production, remains a critical factor influencing industry dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: Availability of low-sulphur green petroleum coke, a key raw material for CPC production, remains a critical factor influencing industry dynamics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the company faces foreign exchange risk as it imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers.
risks_headwinds.quote: The company imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers as a result of which the company faces foreign exchange risk.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management reported that raw material price volatility risks are managed through well-developed ordering processes, diversified suppliers, and quantity management.
risks_headwinds.quote: The raw material price volatility are managed by our well-developed ordering process, diversified suppliers and quantity management.

management_commitments.claim: The completion of projects currently under construction is expected within FY 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: The completion of these projects — expected within FY 2026-27 — is anticipated to substantially increase production capacity, enabling further revenue growth and operating leverage.

management_commitments.claim: The company adopted a forex policy in June 2023 to ensure 100% hedging, where the initial 50% of exposure is hedged immediately upon LC opening and the remaining 50% upon obtaining the SBLC due date.
management_commitments.quote: In order to minimize this risk, the company adopted a forex policy in June, 2023 which ensured 100% hedging. As per hedging policy, initial 50% of the exposure is hedged immediately on LC opening & remaining 50% hedging is done on obtaining SBLC due date.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
